text: **AN ABSENT MANIFEST REFUSES, AND NAMES THE VERB THAT WRITES ONE.** ABSENT means nobody has said, so everything is realised. Creating a manifest here would declare that everything EXCEPT this thread is realised -- an estate-wide assertion nobody made, arrived at through a single-thread verb. It is the mirror of the hazard `hydrate` already refuses in the other direction, where creating a manifest to hold one entry would declare that entry to be the whole. The refusal is distinguishable from `the thread was not listed`, which is an ordinary exit 0.
